name: Error Handling Consistency Hunter
description: A structured prompt for identifying and fixing inconsistent error handling patterns in Go code

context.role: You are an expert Go developer and error handling specialist. You help identify, analyze, and fix inconsistent error handling patterns that could lead to bugs, security issues, or poor user experience.
context.project_type: Go application with SSH functionality and encryption
codebase_patterns: Follows Go idioms and best practices
Implements proper resource cleanup with defer statements

identify_error_handling_patterns.description: Find all error handling patterns in the codebase

patterns_to_check.name: silent_errors
patterns_to_check.description: Errors that are ignored or logged but execution continues
patterns_to_check.impact: Silent failures can lead to data corruption, security issues, or unexpected behavior

patterns_to_check.name: inconsistent_logging
patterns_to_check.description: Different logging approaches for similar errors
patterns_to_check.impact: Inconsistent logging makes debugging difficult and can miss important errors

patterns_to_check.name: missing_error_handling
patterns_to_check.impact: Unhandled errors can cause silent failures and security vulnerabilities

patterns_to_check.name: inconsistent_return_patterns
patterns_to_check.impact: Inconsistent error wrapping makes error tracking difficult

patterns_to_check.name: security_critical_errors
patterns_to_check.description: Security-related errors that should fail fast
patterns_to_check.impact: Security errors should always fail fast and never be ignored

patterns_to_check.name: resource_cleanup_errors
patterns_to_check.description: Errors during resource cleanup that might be ignored
patterns_to_check.impact: Cleanup errors can lead to resource leaks

categories.name: security_critical
categories.handling: Always fail fast with clear error messages

categories.name: operational_critical
categories.handling: Log error and return appropriate error to caller

categories.name: recoverable
categories.handling: Log warning and continue with fallback behavior

requirements: Use structured logging with appropriate log levels
Wrap errors with context using errors.Wrap
Provide clear error messages to users

error_analysis.description: Description of the error handling issue

constraints.no_placeholder_code: All fixes must be complete and functional
constraints.follow_project_patterns: Use existing error handling and logging patterns
constraints.maintain_compatibility: Don't break existing APIs or functionality
constraints.security_first: Security-related errors must always fail fast
constraints.consistent_logging: Use structured logging with appropriate levels

bad_patterns.issue: Silent error handling with inconsistent logging
bad_patterns.fix: Use structured logging and proper error handling
Handle error appropriately or document why it's safe to ignore

good_patterns.pattern: if err != nil { return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load configuration") }
if err != nil { logger.Error("failed to connect", slog.String("error", err.Error())) }
if err != nil { return fmt.Errorf("encryption failed: %w", err) }

before_fixing: Identify all error handling patterns in the file
Categorize errors by criticality and type
Check for existing error handling patterns in similar code
